output.headline: Pays up to $75,846.87 for 2024-25 student accident and sickness insurance through Myers-Stevens & Toohey
output.summary: The board, as policyholder, approves school-time accident and sickness coverage for all enrolled students for the 2024-2025 school year. It covers injuries on school grounds, at school-sponsored activities including interscholastic athletics, while traveling to and from school, and in school vehicles. Payment of the premium to Myers-Stevens & Toohey is capped at $75,846.87.

output.headline: Pays $54,001.96 for 2024-25 catastrophic accident insurance for students and volunteers
output.summary: The board, as policyholder, approves catastrophic accident insurance underwritten by ACE American Insurance Company for the 2024-2025 school year. The $54,001.96 premium goes to the broker, Myers-Stevens & Toohey. It is split between interscholastic athletics ($11,980.96) and other student activities ($42,021.00).

output.headline: Buys technology and audio-visual equipment from CDW Government through another agency's contract, up to $3.9M

money.evidence: total not-to-exceed amount shall be Three Million Nine Hundred Thousand Dollars ($3,900,000)

output.summary: The district is buying through another agency's existing contract (the Monterey County Office of Education's CalSAVE bid) instead of running its own bid. CDW Government will supply technology and audio-visual equipment from February 1, 2024 through December 31, 2026, with a total limit of $3,900,000 and a yearly limit of $1,300,000. The term began before this board vote.

output.headline: Pays $3,905,718 for excess property and liability coverage and $890,000 for excess workers' comp coverage
output.summary: The district pays 2024-25 membership contributions (premiums) to two insurance pools. The larger is $3,905,718 for excess property and liability coverage through Northern California ReLiEF. The other is $890,000 for excess workers' compensation coverage through PRISIM. Both are bought through insurance brokers.

vendor.name: Northern California ReLiEF (NCR) JPA and Public Risk Innovation, Solutions, and Management (PRISIM) JPA

output.headline: Adopts resolution approving 2024-25 Measure G1 applications for named schools, per oversight commission
output.summary: The Board adopts Resolution No. 2324-0256, which carries out the recommendation of the Measure G1 oversight commission to approve the 2024-2025 Measure G1 application for named schools. The item text does not list the schools or give a dollar amount.
